name: Agent Scheduler
description: Sends a prompt to a Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI terminal in Orca at set times — every day, on weekdays, on picked days or dates, or every N minutes. It waits until the terminal is idle, sends through the Orca CLI, and records when the agent finishes, with a one-line result if you ask for one. English and Korean. macOS only for now.
